# Lane 04 r4b — M2 Reflect: evidence generated by a script (one item)

**Workspace:** `tsr-engine` on branch `lane/reflect` (after lane 04 r4a has landed).
**Owns:** `scripts/m2-evidence.sh` (new), `docs/m2-evidence.md`, the README line that says how the fixture store is built.
**Never edits:** any code, test or fixture.
**Reads first:** `AGENTS.md`; this file; `specs/lanes/reviews/04rrr-review.md` (its "Evidence doc" section lists every stale or hand-patched block); the current `docs/m2-evidence.md`.

## Goal

One item: docs/m2-evidence.md has been hand-patched in every round (the last review found Mirror blocks with a stale ledger root and label id, 7 generator tests where there are 8, an elided workspace run claiming 256 passed where there are 263, a wrong claim about when the fixture store is built, and missing commands). Replace hand capture with a script. Write scripts/m2-evidence.sh: run from the workspace root with `bash scripts/m2-evidence.sh > out.md`, it builds the binary, works on a fresh copy of the fixture store under target/ (built with TSR_REGEN_FIXTURES=1 into that copy, never into fixtures/), and for every claim the doc makes prints the exact command (prefixed `$ `) followed by its real stdout, stderr and exit code in a fenced block — the generator tests (all of them), TSR_REGEN_FIXTURES=1 regeneration leaving the episodes byte-identical (sha256 before and after), `tsr reflect` on alpha-00 (text and --json), `tsr reflect --family` for alpha, beta and gamma, `tsr review <task> rejected --return …` and the Mirror after it showing the superseded label, `tsr note`, `tsr task reconcile` over a pending dispatch showing `unresolved retryable` (the documented limitation), `git diff --stat <main> -- crates/tsr-cli/tests/m0_reconstruct.rs fixtures/m0` (empty), and last `rustc --version`, `git rev-parse HEAD`, `docker info` exit code, fmt, clippy and the full `cargo test --workspace --no-fail-fast` summary (every "test result:" line and the names of any failures). Prose between blocks stays (what the corpus is and is not, the residual sign with its arithmetic, the two operator decisions as limitations: the CAS does not decide, the Mirror shows no intent), but every command block in docs/m2-evidence.md is the script's output pasted unchanged, and the doc's first paragraph names the script and the commit it ran at; remove the "nothing here is hand-edited" claim unless it is now true. Fix README.md:152's claim about the fixture store the same way. Re-running the script on the same commit reproduces every block except test timings and the timestamp-derived note and record ids, which the doc names. Conventional commit. Operator notes: this run has ONE item; do it with one implementation task and one review task, nothing else. A create_task refused three times with the same text is a signal, not a retry — stop, post the refusal to the operator, and wait. A passing command is recorded once; do not run a green test again to confirm it. await_task waits at least 60 seconds. Start every command with `export PATH=/usr/local/cargo/bin:$PATH CARGO_HOME=$PWD/.cargo-home` (rust 1.90 with rustfmt and clippy); .cargo-home/ and target/ are build caches — never commit them, exclude them from grep and surveys. If a cargo command reports "can't find crate", run it once in CARGO_TARGET_DIR=$PWD/target-fresh instead of repeating it. After every edit_file, check with grep or git diff in run_command before building; if the shell still shows the old bytes, write the file once from run_command and move on. A command that waits on the build lock is not to be re-issued: its result will arrive as a message. Commit as soon as the test passes. The run is not finished until the director itself has run `cargo test --workspace --no-fail-fast` on the final tip; the two Docker-only m0 tests fail where Docker is absent and are not yours. Every file write goes through the sandbox, never a host path. A review verdict names the file, the line and the behaviour it saw, and says which tests it ran and which were skipped or ignored. No reply needed.

## Definition of done

scripts/m2-evidence.sh exists, runs from the workspace root with no network, and exits 0. Running it on the final tip and diffing its output against docs/m2-evidence.md's command blocks shows no difference except test timings and the named timestamp-derived ids. The doc names the script and the commit and states the two operator decisions as limitations. No code, test or fixture changed. cargo test --workspace --no-fail-fast passes on the final tip apart from the two Docker-only m0 tests where Docker is absent.

## Out of scope

Any code change (if the script exposes a defect, stop and report it to the operator); the lane-01 CAS change; a tsr-domain intent field.
